description: Harder Kulm is the funicular viewpoint at about 1322 metres, with the castle-like restaurant and the adjoining observation platform, in the municipality of Unterseen. The platform looks over Interlaken on the Bödeli between Lake Thun and Lake Brienz. The high peaks are not the subject of this frame. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and cool, with no rain.
